name: Next Departure
description: The next departures from one of your stops for an overlay zone, as outlined text: a line per route and destination, with its next times. It uses the device's transit provider (Transitland's settings, My Stops) and the answers it keeps, which a Departure Board of the same stop shares. What you could no longer catch, counting your walk, is left out, and with nothing left the overlay is taken off.

properties.name: stop
properties.title: Stop
properties.description: One of My Stops (Transitland settings). Its walk time decides which departures can still be caught, and the time to leave.

properties.name: timeStyle
properties.title: Times
properties.description: How the times read, clock times both (never a countdown, which is wrong a minute after the refresh). clock: when it leaves, 12:07. leave-by: when to leave for it, the walk taken off. ~ marks a timetable time, +3 a live one that is late.

properties.name: perLine
properties.title: Times per Line
properties.description: How many of a route's next departures each line shows. Two by default, so a refresh just after one leaves still shows one.

properties.name: weight
properties.title: Weight
properties.description: How heavy the letters are. bold: the font's bold face. heavy: bolder than the font has it.

properties.name: offset
properties.title: Edge Offset
properties.description: How far the text is from the screen's edge, in pixels: from the top edge in a top zone, from the bottom edge in a bottom zone.
